question.text: Sand is being dropped on a conveyer belt at the rate of $2 \mathrm{~kg}$ per second. The force necessary to keep the belt moving with a constant speed of $3 \mathrm{~ms}^{-1}$ will be

solution.text:
Here, rate of fall of sand on conveyer belt,
$$
\frac{d m}{d t}=2 \mathrm{~kg} \mathrm{~s}^{-1}
$$
Conveyer belt speed $v=3 \mathrm{~ms}^{-1}$ Force $F=$ ?
$$
F=v \frac{d m}{d t}=3 \times 2=6 \mathrm{~N}
$$
